interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add edge lines or a center line to narrow the perceived travel lanes and organize traffic flow.

interventions.title: Construct Dedicated Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway and parking areas to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Definition
interventions.description: Use curbs and landscaping to define specific driveway entrances, reducing the area where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Crossings
interventions.description: Remove parking near common crossing points or driveway entrances to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Defined Driveway Aprons
interventions.description: Replace the continuous paved frontage with defined driveway entrances to reduce the area where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to provide designated locations for residents to cross between housing blocks.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical buffer between the roadway and the pedestrian zone while also providing shade.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Continuity Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and level across the driveways to clearly signal pedestrian priority and define the walkway.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cuts and separate the parking pads from the sidewalk to minimize the area of conflict between cars and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or grass verge between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations for residents.
